parameters.query:
select id, chat_id, course, title, days_left,
       to_char(due_at at time zone 'Europe/Paris', 'Dy DD Mon, HH24:MI') as due_pretty
from (
  select *,
         (due_at at time zone 'Europe/Paris')::date
           - (now() at time zone 'Europe/Paris')::date as days_left
  from deadlines
  where status = 'open'
) d
where days_left between 0 and 7
  and (   (days_left <= 1 and not reminded_1)
       or (days_left <= 3 and not reminded_3)
       or (days_left <= 7 and not reminded_7) )
order by chat_id, due_at;

update deadlines
set reminded_7 = true,
    reminded_3 = reminded_3 or ((due_at at time zone 'Europe/Paris')::date
                                - (now() at time zone 'Europe/Paris')::date) <= 3,
    reminded_1 = reminded_1 or ((due_at at time zone 'Europe/Paris')::date
                                - (now() at time zone 'Europe/Paris')::date) <= 1,
    updated_at = now()
where id = any(string_to_array($1, ',')::bigint[]);
